original_card.question: Can one exact all-size/compiler, precision, hosting or restoration implication be proved or falsified?
methods: Prove one missing implication with explicit quantified hypotheses.
Find an exact counterexample at the claimed interface boundary.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected review scope and choose one exact all-size or precision implication.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write its quantified inputs and conclusion; find a missing hypothesis or construct a minimal exact adversarial instance.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Finite supplier improvements are useful only under the retained transfer obligations.
allowed_variations: Choose one tape, precision, hosting or restoration lemma.
scope_change_triggers: Replacing a quantified obligation with another finite smoke test.

chooser.card_note: First-choice card selected-stock-envelope was declined under the pair-collision rule (philippeVV live claim comment 18932014 and completed PR2084/PR2120 first-stage coefficient work); second-choice card uniform-transfer-audit taken instead.

actual_scope: One hosting transfer implication, quantified over pinned bytes: in the universe of all 57 *.py members of research/complex-t16-rare-pattern-exchanges/upstream1087.tar.gz plus five named main-tree scripts (including the import closure of check_frontier1094.py), machine-check that no post-emit consumer of the hosted template performs a name-directed read of the 15 fields PR1959 recorded as audit-unread, enumerate every dynamic-access and whole-object channel by which those fields could still reach a post-emit acceptance decision, and record what would change downstream (the emit-stage file-hash provenance binding is the only such channel).
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one exact all-size/compiler/precision/hosting/restoration implication with explicit quantified hypotheses; the drawn first-choice card selected-stock-envelope matched an already-claimed recent object (philippeVV 2026-10-14 18:57Z claim comment 18932014, plus completed PR2084/PR2120), so the second-choice card was taken and refined to PR1959's explicitly labelled informal claim ('a text search, not a proof'), one named hosting acceptance boundary of the selected chain.
bottleneck_link: The selected record's scope retains whole-call hosting and all-size/transfer obligations as inherited assumptions; PR1959's informal read-set gap sat directly on the hosted-template acceptance boundary of those obligations. Upgrading it to a pinned machine check removes one informal step from the transfer chain and hands the next worker an exact channel map; no kappa arithmetic is changed.
stop_rule: One bounded experiment: the AST inventory plus channel map over the pinned universe. Stop at the first unresolvable dynamic access of one of the 15 names (falsifier) or on inventory completion; one bounded pivot maximum (receiver-closure extension to the frontier1094 import closure).
evidence: research/hosted-template-postemit-fields/EXPECTED.json pinned inventory (62 files, 58 name-directed occurrences, 54 dynamic sites), verify.py self-tests PASS_POSTEMIT_FIELD_READSET; scope-key overlap searches recorded in the PR (find_overlap.py, 2026-10-15T02:28Z and 02:36Z snapshots).
